descriptionChirho: A person from Cyrene, the Greek colony in North Africa (modern Libya), used as a gentilicium (ethnic adjective/noun) throughout the NT. Simon the Cyrenian is compelled to carry Jesus' cross in Matt 27:32, Mark 15:21, and Luke 23:26 (arb al-qīrīnī/qayrawāniyy, fra Cyrénéen, heb קוּרֵינָאִי/קוּרֵנִי, hin kurenī, kor gurene saram). In Acts 6:9 Cyrenians are among the Hellenistic synagogue members disputing with Stephen (spa de los Kyrēnaîoi). Acts 11:20 mentions Cyrenians (plural Κυρηναῖοι) among those preaching to Greeks in Antioch, and Acts 13:1 identifies Lucius the Cyrenian as a prophet in the Antioch church. All four auto-clusters are inflectional variants (AMS, NMP, GMP, NMS) of one proper gentilicium.
